constraints: Worker execution requires exact DONE BB-074 and BB-059 bindings; incompatible delivered semantics yield PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION.
Candidate selection is deterministic from immutable BB-074 evidence and may choose at most one bounded HOW/configuration axis.

architectureDecisions: D1 — Worker input is exact DONE BB-074 delivery-value evidence plus exact DONE BB-059 HOW-evolution authority. BB-075 does not preselect an optimization during research and cannot consume mutable/unbound summaries.

D2 — Run a deterministic HOW_IMPROVEMENT_SELECTION_V1 reducer over BB-074 unit/attempt evidence. Eligible axes are STRATEGY_POLICY, CONTEXT_POLICY or TOOL_POLICY; the selected fingerprint must be observed and addressable through an already delivered bounded HOW/configuration seam.

D3 — Selection precedence is: eligible critical lifecycle/recovery failure, repeated quality/failure fingerprint, repeated known-cost inefficiency, repeated prompt-input/model-turn inefficiency. Within one class choose affected registered-unit count descending then fingerprintId lexicographically.

D4 — If no eligible observed fingerprint maps to a delivered bounded HOW seam, BB-075 returns INCONCLUSIVE with reason NO_ELIGIBLE_CANDIDATE and does not satisfy its objective. KEEP_BASELINE is valid only after a real candidate was constructed and held-out evaluated.

D5 — Before candidate construction, exclude every task digest used/reserved by BB-065/077/081/074 from pinned Terminal-Bench 2.1, preflight remaining tasks through the delivered BB-065 substrate port with oracle 5/5 plus nop fail 1/1, sort by immutable bundle digest, then seal six IMPROVEMENT_HOLDOUT and four RELEASE_RESERVE tasks. This is task admissibility, not a redefinition of generic substrate calibration.
D6 — BB-075 may execute only IMPROVEMENT_HOLDOUT. Any model execution over RELEASE_RESERVE before BB-076 invalidates the partition.

D7 — BASELINE is the exact supported BB-074/BB-081 profile with current HOW policy; CANDIDATE differs only by one immutable HOW_PROFILE_V1 bound to the selected failure fingerprint and metric family. Task/prompt/environment/tools/model/provider/budgets/evaluator remain fixed.

D8 — Run six tasks x two repeats x two arms = 24 registered arm units with counterbalanced order and fresh substrate/runtime/provider state. Register every unit/attempt through @exharness/benchmark; every retry/failure remains visible in the shared AttemptLedger/evidence/accounting truth.

D9 — The selected fingerprint maps to exactly one preregistered primary metric family: FAILURE_RATE, PROVIDER_COST, PROMPT_INPUT or MODEL_TURNS. Unknown primary evidence cannot promote and is never zero-filled.

D10 — PROMOTE_CANDIDATE requires complete known primary evidence, no quality/safety/currentness regression and the metric-specific minimum effect. A fully evaluated real candidate that fails the effect/regression gate yields KEEP_BASELINE; missing/drifted evidence yields INCONCLUSIVE.

D11 — Promotion uses BB-059 proposal/promoter/currentness semantics only. Existing active/recovery attempts retain their old immutable binding; rollback is a successor generation selecting an exact prior accepted profile.

D12 — Product/runtime source writes are forbidden. If the selected measured bottleneck needs new runtime architecture rather than a delivered HOW seam, BB-075 cannot fabricate a candidate; it returns INCONCLUSIVE/NO_ELIGIBLE_CANDIDATE and records follow-up research.
implementationSlices: S1 — Dependency/evidence binding: implement benchmarks/delivery_evolution/dependency.mjs to resolve exact DONE BB-074 implementation-result/judgment/decision evidence and exact DONE BB-059 delivered HOW-evolution export at Worker start; emit DELIVERY_EVOLUTION_INPUT_V1 with ref+hash identities and fail PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION on missing/incompatible delivery.

S2 — Evidence-selected candidate: implement selection.mjs to reduce only DELIVERY_EVOLUTION_INPUT_V1 unit/attempt evidence into exactly one HOW_IMPROVEMENT_SELECTION_V1. If no observed eligible fingerprint has an exact deliveredSeamRef, emit NO_ELIGIBLE_CANDIDATE and terminate INCONCLUSIVE; do not create a fake candidate or KEEP_BASELINE success.

S3 — Cohort seal: implement cohort.mjs over the delivered BB-065 substrate/task identity contract to build the prior-task exclusion set, preflight remaining Terminal-Bench 2.1 tasks, and materialize one immutable partition with six IMPROVEMENT_HOLDOUT plus four unopened RELEASE_RESERVE digests before candidate execution.

S4 — Candidate materialization: implement candidate.mjs to create one HOW_PROFILE_V1 through the delivered HOW seam named by the selection, compute a field-level baseline/candidate diff, and reject any WHAT/acceptance/evaluator/model/provider/budget/task change or packages/** source mutation.

S5 — Held-out execution/report: implement run.mjs/report.mjs to execute all 24 registered BASELINE/CANDIDATE units through @exharness/benchmark + the delivered substrate port with fresh state, preserve every shared-ledger attempt/retry/provider failure, and emit matched quality/failure/cost/input/turn/currentness evidence for the selected metric family.

S6 — Deterministic decision/currentness: implement decision.mjs to return PROMOTE_CANDIDATE|KEEP_BASELINE|INCONCLUSIVE from the frozen metric gate. Only PROMOTE constructs the BB-059 promotion proposal; current-head freshness is rechecked by the delivered promoter, old attempts keep old bindings, and regression rollback remains a successor generation.

S7 — Publication handoff: emit immutable selection/partition/candidate/run/report/decision refs, update Living truth only with the independently verified outcome, and hand the still-unopened RELEASE_RESERVE manifest to BB-076. A KEEP_BASELINE publication proves a real candidate was evaluated; NO_ELIGIBLE_CANDIDATE remains INCONCLUSIVE.

arms.BASELINE: supported BB-074/BB-081 profile + current HOW policy

evaluationContract.fresh: task environment + runtime state + provider session per registered arm unit
evaluationContract.attempts: append-only; retries never overwrite prior attempts

metricContract.FAILURE_RATE: fewer target-fingerprint attempts, eliminate at least two matched baseline occurrences, candidate accepted quality >= baseline, no new critical fingerprint, recovery/currentness negatives pass
metricContract.PROVIDER_COST: median cost ratio <=0.90 with known cost, accepted quality >= baseline, turns ratio <=1.00, no new critical fingerprint
metricContract.PROMPT_INPUT: median prompt-input ratio <=0.90, accepted quality >= baseline, known cost ratio <=1.10 when available, no new critical fingerprint
metricContract.MODEL_TURNS: median turn ratio <=0.90, accepted quality >= baseline, known cost ratio <=1.10 when available, no new critical fingerprint

decisionContract.promote: real selected candidate + complete 24-unit cohort + known primary metric + all quality/safety/currentness gates + selected minimum effect
decisionContract.keep: real selected candidate was fully held-out evaluated and complete valid evidence shows insufficient effect or a conclusive regression
decisionContract.inconclusive: NO_ELIGIBLE_CANDIDATE, unavailable delivered bounded seam, missing unit, unknown primary metric, verifier/task/profile drift or incomplete required negative evidence
decisionContract.authority: frozen deterministic reducer; Jev validates evidence claims and cannot rewrite outcome
